fuente.titulo: Pope’s visit confirmed: ‘I look forward to returning to Latin America’

titular: Pope Leo XIV to visit Latin America in November
bajada: Trip confirmed to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, Nov. 6-17
caption: The Holy See Press Office has confirmed Pope Leo XIV's upcoming Apostolic Journey to Latin America, with stops in Uruguay, Argentina and Peru scheduled for November 6-17. The Pope said he looks forward to returning to the region. Source: Vatican News, Oct 26, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A map-like composition suggesting South America with small symbolic icons for Uruguay, Argentina and Peru; a papal silhouette in formal vestments stands at the upper right, looking toward the continent, left and center空ace kept open.
